title: Tim Taylor says the president handed him the item at dinner

tellings.quote: And he said, "I was at the dinner table with the president and handed me that."

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, whose story of attracting UFOs was the subject of a podcast episode with host Jesse Michels, passes on something he says a man named Tim Taylor told him. According to Bledsoe, Taylor said a president handed him a certain item while they sat together at the dinner table. No date or place is given, but if true it would put the item, and Taylor, very close to the top of government.
